memo.subject: Request for review: DPWH road contract 26JB0088, Zamboanga Del Norte, ₱49.8 million
background: Fragmented procurement records and limited oversight capacity make it difficult to identify which Philippine road projects need closer scrutiny. The Commission on Audit's 2024 Annual Audit Report on the DPWH reported locally funded projects worth ₱138.23 billion that were not efficiently implemented: 1,435 finished late (₱77.4 billion), 523 suspended (₱33.6 billion), 491 carrying negative slippage of 10 per cent or more (₱19.2 billion), 114 not started (₱6.72 billion) and 33 terminated (₱1.29 billion) — 2,596 projects in all, most of them identified only after the money had been spent.

Project BantAI addresses this gap through AI-assisted risk screening that supports timely, targeted human review. It integrates public DPWH and PhilGEPS data and checks each contract against risk indicators that were tested on past project outcomes. A reviewer verifies the evidence before any case is referred, so that oversight offices can make informed decisions on which contracts to examine first.
memo.disclaimer: This is a request for review, not a finding of irregularity. BantAI ranks contracts by tested risk signs so that limited audit time can go to the contracts most worth a look. A sign is a reason to check, not evidence of wrongdoing, and several ordinary explanations may fit any of them.

No name match between the winner's PCAB Authorized Managing Officer and an elected official of the same area. Provincial political-family figures are shown on the case page as context only and are never scored.
